name: prompt-672
image_purpose: stylized toy-store selfie and costume reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic toy-store mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with clearly fictional generic animal mascots.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman winking at the camera, holding a smartphone, wearing a modest iridescent metallic short-sleeve dress with secure coverage and a generic gray-purple rabbit-ear plush hat.
prompt.composition_elements: Colorful merchandise store with generic fox and rabbit plush toys, soft neon accents, mirror reflection, detailed fabric and plush texture, face and upper body in focus. Exclude named franchises, official merchandise, badges, logos, and signatures.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft retail lighting with colorful neon accents and gentle volumetric bloom, lively playful atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror selfie, portrait 3:4, sharp eyes and phone, realistic reflection, natural skin texture, high detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman winks in a toy-store mirror selfie while wearing a modest iridescent metallic dress with secure coverage and a generic gray-purple rabbit-ear plush hat. Surround her with generic fox and rabbit plush merchandise, colorful shelves, soft neon accents, and realistic mirror reflections. No named franchise, official merchandise, logo, badge, or signature.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, corset, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, franchise character likeness, official logo, badge, watermark, text, distorted plush, scary toy face, malformed hands, public figure likeness.
